Acceptance Rule: Exact release and runbook complete; all deviations dispositioned
Required Evidence: Release ID; package versions; completed runbook; job IDs; deviation log

Acceptance Rule: Material source; Plan1; ApexPlan ASO; dashboard; and Smart View controls reconcile at approved precision
Required Evidence: Source totals; rejects; load results; calculation results; publish results; control totals

Acceptance Rule: Representative positive and negative access; rule; workflow; audit; and service-account tests pass
Required Evidence: User-role matrix; test results; exceptions; reviewer acceptance

Acceptance Rule: Critical rules; interfaces; schedules; publishing; reports; and reruns are repeatable and accepted
Required Evidence: Job IDs; timings; interface results; repeatability; reconciliations

Acceptance Rule: No uncontrolled release blocker; all residual risks have explicit disposition and authority
Required Evidence: Defect snapshot; retests; regression; waivers; residual-risk approvals

Acceptance Rule: Critical journeys meet targets; approved limitations are monitored and supportable
Required Evidence: Production smoke timing; capacity result; limitation; monitoring; target release

Acceptance Rule: Approval ownership; schedule; cutoff; calendar; and exception route are active
Required Evidence: Workflow tests; task schedule; calendar; owner acceptance

Acceptance Rule: Named recovery point and tested restore path remain viable before the rollback deadline
Required Evidence: Snapshot; restore evidence; rollback deadline; continuity instructions

Acceptance Rule: Roster; monitoring; severity; SLA; escalation; runbooks; and handoff are accepted
Required Evidence: Roster; support model; alerts; runbooks; contact list; handoff approval

Acceptance Rule: Users; training; limitations; operating ownership; and production acceptance are explicit
Required Evidence: Readiness list; training; limitations; ownership; acceptance record
